description: This file defines the SynchronizeNotes class responsible for synchronizing notes between local and remote sources, supporting different synchronization methods and handling various update scenarios.

classes.name: SynchronizeNotes
classes.description: Main class for synchronizing notes between local and remote sources, supporting different synchronization methods.

classes.name: NoteAction
classes.description: Sealed interface representing actions (Create, Update, Delete) to be performed on notes during synchronization.

classes.name: SyncNotesResult
classes.description: Data class encapsulating the results of the synchronization process, including lists of local and remote updates and new mappings.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Main method to perform synchronization of notes based on specified method (MAPPING or TITLE), comparing local and remote notes, and generating update actions.

methods.name: logDebug
methods.description: Helper method for logging debug messages.
